subject: Private Offer: accelerator credit request and rev-share realignment for EduAccelerate
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@eduaccelerate.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@eduaccelerate.com
Date: 2027-10-13T09:12:00Z
Subject: Private offer proposal & ask for accelerator credit + rev-share alignment

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was excited about the perf numbers and the billing predictability you showed. We discussed internally and Procurement asked me to surface two items that need to be captured in the private offer if we are to move forward this quarter:

1) An "accelerator" one-time credit to cover implementation and pilot costs (~$120k), ideally amortized over the first 12 months on the invoice.
2) A rev-share floor realignment for our education bundle SKU: we currently have a short-term target to bring unit economics in line with our margins; asking for a 12% rev-share floor versus your standard 20%.

Attached is a draft SOW and a rough private offer payload we used with another vendor for reference. We need to close contract paperwork and the marketplace private offer window for AWS next week.

Can you advise on internal approval path and whether Redwood can accommodate these two items under a private offer? If there are alternatives (e.g., larger up-front credit + higher floor) we are open to options.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, EduAccelerate

Attachments: EduAccel_SOW_draft_v2.pdf; PrivateOffer_Draft.json

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-13T10:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Private offer proposal & ask for accelerator credit + rev-share alignment

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding EduAccelerate's ask. Short summary:
- One-time accelerator credit requested: $120k, amortized over 12 months.
- Rev-share floor for the education bundle SKU: request 12% (our standard private offer floor is 20% on marketplace listings).
- Business: expected 12-month ARR if converted to private offer + upsell $1.1M; first-year recognized ARR ~ $700k due to pilot credits.

Options I propose for exec consideration:
A) Approve $120k credit capped at 12 months, accept 12% rev-share floor for 18 months, require co-sell motion + joint GTM plan.
B) Approve $80k credit + 15% rev-share floor, escalated onboarding support (RSE hours) in lieu of full credit.
C) Deny rev-share concession, offer $60k credit with extended payment terms (Net60).

Requesting sign-off for Option A if the execs agree this is strategic for Edu vertical and likely to net >$1M ARR in 24 months. If we want legal redlines, flag and I'll route. Need an answer by 10/14 COB to hit AWS private-offer publish cadence.

— Lauren
Director, Cloud Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference

On 2027-10-13 at 09:12, Marta Ruiz wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was excited about the perf numbers...

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-13T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer proposal & ask for accelerator credit + rev-share alignment

Lauren — quick notes from my side after scanning the attachments:
- Marketplace policy: for education-bundle SKUs with promotional credits we typically require maintaining a minimum endorsement rev-share of 18% in AWS private offers to protect channel economics. There are exceptions but those need legal + marketplace approvals.
- Financial impact: Option A reduces expected gross revs on the Edu bundle by ~6ppt in year 1; modeled EAC ~ $95k impact to contribution margin in year 1 (net of projected upsell).
- Risk: credits amortized over 12 months must be reflected in private offer terms and in our billing pipeline; billing ops needs the PrivateOffer_Draft.json to be finalized now.

I recommend we: 1) Ask EduAccelerate to accept a 15% floor instead of 12% as a negotiating midpoint, 2) Cap total accelerator credits at $120k with clawback if milestones not met, and 3) Add co-sell commitments in the SOW (two joint references + quarterly business reviews).

I'll have legal review the redline in the afternoon — attaching a quick redline summary (redline_terms.docx). If you want, I can escalate to Revenue Ops / Marketplace team for a formal waiver; that will add 24-48 hours.

— Karthik
Head, Deal Desk

> On 2027-10-13 at 10:05, lauren_bishop@redwood.com wrote:
> > Karthik / Marissa — forwarding EduAccelerate's ask...

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-13T15:04:00Z
Subject: Exec approval request: EduAccelerate private offer (time-sensitive)

Rishi — looping you directly for executive sign-off. Quick context:
- Account: EduAccelerate (education SaaS), estimated 12-mo ARR opportunity $1.1M, strong pilot motion with three anchor customers in their network.
- Ask: Approve Option A (see forwarded) — $120k accelerator credit amortized over 12 months; approve 12% rev-share floor for Edu bundle SKU for 18 months, contingent on co-sell commitments and milestones.
- Why escalate: AWS private-offer publish slot is next Friday; failure to publish now likely bumps closing into next quarter and risks losing anchor pilots.
- Tradeoffs: Year 1 margin hit, but projected payback in 18 months with cross-sell. Compliance and marketplace waiver required — Karhtik estimates 24-48 hours for waiver flow.

Request: Please confirm one of the following by EOD 10/14 so we can finalize the private offer payload: Approve Option A as written / Approve with modification (please specify) / Decline.

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-min sync with the Marketplace team to walk through the waiver path and draft docs.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Cloud Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference

> On 2027-10-13 at 11:22, karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:
> > Lauren — quick notes from my side after scanning the attachments...

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-14T16:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: EduAccelerate private offer (time-sensitive)

Lauren — thanks for the concise summary. I approve moving forward with a modified Option A under these conditions:
1) Credit cap confirmed at $120k total and amortized only if we receive a signed SOW within 30 days.
2) Rev-share floor approved at 15% (compromise between their 12% ask and our standard 20%), for a limited 12-month pilot window; after 12 months, revert to standard terms unless renewal negotiations explicitly extend the concession.
3) Require co-sell KPI commitments in SOW (minimum 2 joint reference customers by month 9).
4) Deal Desk to prepare a waiver request for the AWS private offer team and Legal to review the SOW redlines; no publishing until waiver ack.

If these conditions are OK with Karthik and Legal, proceed and publish the private offer to AWS marketplace. Please push the updated private offer payload to HubSpot and tag DEAL-1987 in Jira so Ops can pick it up.

— Rishi
VP, Cloud Sales
Redwood Inference
